recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a woman in a shimmering satin blazer and patterned shirt, captured in a dynamic, slightly tilted pose against a minimalist studio background featuring a dark, textured wall relief. The lighting is warm and directional, creating high-contrast highlights on the fabric and hair.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm sepia-toned subject against a stark white and dark bronze background
Shimmering satin texture of the blazer contrasting with the matte wall relief
Dynamic, off-center subject pose balanced by top-left justified typography
Interplay between the organic hair texture and the geometric lines of the background art
coreInvariants: High-key upper background with low-key lower background
Classical serif typography with a decorative flourish

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium shot, woman slightly angled to the right, occupying 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The reflective sheen on the blazer's lapels and the subject's face looking downward.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left text, moves down the subject's hair to the hands, and circles back through the dark background relief.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white space in the upper left quadrant provides breathing room for the title.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm sepia and bronze (mid-tones and shadows)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast; deep blacks in the relief and bright highlights on the satin.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to earth tones and metallics

letterConstructionRules: Tight letter spacing for the main name
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial 'J' features an elongated, sweeping tail that drops below the baseline
The 'R' has a slightly flared leg
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for the name paired with a delicate, wide-tracked lowercase serif for the title.
graphicDevices: Faint line-art heart icon behind the text
Horizontal color block dividing the background into white and tan sections

preserve: The golden-olive color of the text

candidateDirections.reason: High contrast and sharp serifs match the primary name style.
Provides the elegant, softer feel needed for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A medium shot of a woman with dark layered hair, wearing a shiny bronze satin blazer over a leopard-print shirt. She is looking down and slightly to the side in a candid, mid-movement pose. The background is split: the top half is off-white with a dark, square, textured relief sculpture on the right; the bottom half is a solid tan floor. Warm sepia lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add stacked text in the top-left corner. The top and bottom lines should be in a large, golden-olive serif font (all caps). The middle line should be in a small, dark bronze, lowercase serif font with wide letter spacing. Behind the text, place a very faint, thin-lined heart-shaped graphic.

verificationChecks: Is the blazer's texture visibly satin/reflective?
Is the 'J' in the bottom line elongated?
Is the color palette strictly warm/sepia?
Is the background relief sculpture dark and textured?

adjustableVariables: Complexity of the background relief pattern
The specific pattern on the inner shirt (e.g., floral vs leopard)
The scale of the heart graphic behind the text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible against the white background
Check that the satin highlights don't blow out the facial details
Verify the horizontal split in the background is straight
Confirm the hair has a natural, slightly wind-swept texture
recipe.reuseFormula: Medium shot + satin blazer + sepia tone + high-contrast serif typography + asymmetrical studio layout.
